justification: No attacker-controlled data is processed and no unsafe memory operations are performed.
analysis: This function does not process any attacker-influenced inputs such as packet contents, netlink attributes, or user-supplied lengths/offsets. It only initializes workqueues with fixed parameters and handles basic error cases by cleaning up previously allocated resources. No memory is read, written, copied, indexed, allocated, or freed in a way that could be manipulated by an attacker.
